title: 3 Space Facts That Will Break Your Brain

scenes.text: Three facts about space so strange, scientists still argue about them.
Number one. A day on Venus is longer than its entire year.
Number two. Neutron stars spin seven hundred times every single second.
Number three. There is a cloud in space that smells like rum and tastes like raspberries.
And we have explored less than one percent of our own galaxy. Follow for more space secrets.
